17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 1401 W. 71st Street/7104 S. Loomis Boulevard,
Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 4,676.25 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change in order to permit two (2)
dwelling units within the basement of the existing two-story four (4)
dwelling unit residential building. When complete, the existing building
will contain a total of six (6) dwelling units. The height and footprint of the
existing principal building and detached garage will remain without change.
The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will continue to be
supported by two (2) garage parking spaces at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant
to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-1003-I of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking
requirement for a Transit Served Location from 50% (1 parking space) to
zero, reduce the front setback to 9 ft.-2 in. and is seeking all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,928 square feet (1.19 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 779.38 square feet per D.U.
(6 residential units)

(C)  *The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (67"-69"-71* Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the
off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location from 50% (1 parking
space) to zero.

() Setbacks:
a. *Front Setback: 9 feet-2 inches
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 1 feet-6 inches
West Side: 5 feet-8 inches
c. Rear Setback: 42 feet

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-I, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the front setback
to 9 ft.-2 in.
